name: 993 wheel center cap, AlSi10Mg bionic (PicoGK)
material_candidate: AlSi10Mg LPBF (screening; commercial original declared plastic)
picogk_enhancement: Bionic: the structure under the face (replacing the lattice sandwich and radial gussets) is grown along the load paths of a 200 N push and a 100 N pull-out on the face and a 100 N side knock on the rim (all assumptions), the cap seated on its skirt lip and held by the tab barbs, by 3D SIMP topology optimization (source/bionic.json, topopt.py); PicoGK smooths the density into organic members. The 76 mm domed face with its skirt, the 60 mm centering ring bore, the 46 mm height, the four clip tabs and their barbs are kept exact (source/bionic_keepins.py). Loads are assumptions until measured.

ring_inner_diameter_mm.note: inner diameter 60 mm, read as the centering ring bore as in the build123d F0 (interpretation)

face_thickness_mm.note: sandwich thickness at the rim (F0 solid face is 2 mm); thicker to hold a lattice core

dome_height_mm.note: face crown; F0 face is flat

outer_skirt_height_mm.note: F0 OUTER_SKIRT_HEIGHT_MM, measured from the face top at the rim

tab_count.note: F0 TAB_COUNT; OEM retention is a press fit per FVD - tabs are a concept choice

tab_length_mm.note: free tab length below the slotted ring end (F0 tab spans z 14..44 inside the ring)

tab_barb_mm.note: F0 bead 2 mm radial minus 0.5 mm overlap

rib_count.note: radial gussets between centering ring and outer skirt

drain_hole_diameter_mm.note: powder drains from the open-cell core through the underside skin

open_interfaces: wheel center bore diameter and clip groove
tab count and barb geometry of the OEM cap
height conflict: partworks 46 mm vs FVD product block 1.9 cm (may be a shipping envelope)
OEM retention is a press fit with two removal holes (FVD); clip tabs here are a concept choice
